theorem exists_prime_lsym (r : ℕ) (hr : Nat.Coprime r 12) (Q : Finset ℕ)
    (hQ : ∀ q ∈ Q, Odd3 q) (e : ℕ → ZMod 2) (F : Finset ℕ) :
    ∃ p, p.Prime ∧ p % 12 = r % 12 ∧ p ∉ F ∧ ∀ q ∈ Q, lsym (p : ℤ) q = e q := by
